argument.says: What the component is given: holons in order, among them expressions, which are holons too.

component.says: The component the mount calls, when it names one; otherwise one is found for what it is given.

from.says: Where the holon was born from, as a path in the files it arrived from.

offer.says: What the mount offers everything it draws, nearer offers shadowing it: settings a component takes and its slot leaves unsaid, by their names, and what components look for, as the favorites, or the search a mount's menu is drawn by.

body.says: A call: a component and its argument, what it is given to draw. The argument is a selection, holons in order: one is drawn as itself, several as a list. A mount is the one thing that stands still to be changed, so the root of what one looks at is a mount, and every move is a new version of it.
body.title: Mount
